notes:
**Ice Fusion**

Deal 5 arcane damage to target hero. If this was **fused**, instead deal X arcane damage, where X is 5 plus the number of Frostbites, Ice afflictions, and **frozen** cards they control. Representative only: unfused_printed_five_arcane. Other pitch siblings, alternate targets and unexercised branches receive no credit. All four live/manual; only native entry-point actions.
